svg.text: Deployment Topology — Live Cloudflare Workers/D1 Edge vs Containerized Node.js
Migrated on 2026-11-26 from expired Railway container hosting to zero-cost Cloudflare Workers + D1 Edge Platform
Production Target (Active): Cloudflare Edge
URL: https://bhel-portal.likhithb2005.workers.dev/
Frontend: client/dist served via Workers [assets] binding
(not_found_handling = single-page-application, run_worker_first = true)
API Worker: worker/src/index.js (Hono router, <1ms PBKDF2)
Database: Cloudflare D1 SQLite (bhel-portal-db, 7-day Time Travel)
Secrets: JWT_SECRET injected via `wrangler secret put` (excluded from repo)
Alternative Self-Hosted Target: Docker / Node.js
Docker 2-Stage Build (Dockerfile, node:22-alpine):
Stage 1: npm install + vite build -> client/dist
Stage 2: server/ production deps + static serving on PORT 5000
Config Profiles: railway.json & render.yaml (Render disk /var/data)
Persistence: Native node:sqlite WAL file at DB_PATH env var
Historical Note: Original Railway apps expired (HTTP 404); data migrated
Local Development & Isolated Verification Flow
Local Express Dev: `npm run server` (port 5000) + `npm run client` (Vite port 5173 proxying /api -> 5000)
Local Worker Dev: `cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply bhel-portal-db --local && npx wrangler dev` (using local .dev.vars)
Automated Verification: `node --test server/tests/*.test.js` runs isolated HTTP + :memory: / disposable SQLite end-to-end tests
Strict Repo Hygiene: .sqlite, .dev.vars, .env, .wrangler/, node_modules/, and real D1 database_id excluded from public Git commits
